_note: Defaults from LATRA's ride-hailing fare order (Government Gazette, 17 Apr 2026, in force ~1 May 2026): cars base 1,100-1,200, per km 1,100-1,300, per min 120-150, trips up to 1 km 4,000-5,000; motorcycles up to 1 km 1,500-2,000; three-wheelers up to 1 km 3,000-4,000. No per-km bands were published for boda/bajaji: those use Bolt's last public rates (Nov 2024: boda 350/km, bajaji 550/km) + its 22% May 2026 rise. XL has no LATRA band (priced ~30% above Standard). Operator confirms and edits in the admin. Cancellation fee per ride type applies after the free 2 minutes or once the driver has arrived, and to no-shows. Surge: per busy area, capped per ride type by surge_max (Standard 1.08 = LATRA's top per-km band; others off until the operator sets a cap).
